description: This file contains a comprehensive PHPUnit test class 'BasicUserRoleManagerTest' for the 'BasicUserRoleManager' within the 'OrangeHRM' System. It primarily tests the functionality related to user roles, permissions, access control, and homepage/module defaults, focusing on various user scenarios such as admin, supervisor, ESS, and others. It includes setup routines, mock objects, and a suite of test cases verifying behavior of access rights, entity accessibility, role filtering, and configuration of user interfaces.

classes.name: BasicUserRoleManagerTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing various aspects of BasicUserRoleManager, including role-based access control, homepage setup, permissions, and user scenario distinctions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loading fixtures, resetting database tables, and creating a mock kernel with helper services.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmployeeIdsExcludeIncludeRoles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of accessible employee IDs with role inclusion/exclusion filters, ensuring role-based access restriction works properly.

methods.name: testAreEmployeesAccessibleAdmin
methods.description: Verifies that an admin user can access all employee entities, including with unavailable employee IDs.

methods.name: testAreEmployeesAccessibleSupervisor
methods.description: Checks supervisor's access control over employees, confirming subordinate access rights based on supervisor-employees relationships.

methods.name: testAreEmployeesAccessibleESS
methods.description: Ensures that ESS users do not have access to employee entities, verifying system's restriction for ESS roles.

methods.name: testIsEmployeeAccessibleAdmin
methods.description: Verifies admin and supervisor users' access to specific employee entities by ID.

methods.name: testIsEmployeeAccessibleSupervisor
methods.description: Checks supervisor's per-employee accessibility, including multiple subordinate scenarios.

methods.name: testIsEmployeeAccessibleESS
methods.description: Tests that ESS users cannot access employee entities.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleSystemUsersAdmin
methods.description: Checks that admin users can access the list of system users.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleSystemUsersESSSupervisor
methods.description: Verifies that ESS users and supervisors with subordinates have restricted access to system users.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleOperationalCountriesESSSupervisor
methods.description: Tests access to operational countries (or similar entities) for various user roles, ensuring restrictions are properly enforced.

methods.name: testGetUserRoles
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of user roles, including handling of multiple roles and role filtering.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissions
methods.description: Confirms that screen permissions are correctly fetched and propagated for a user role.

methods.name: testFilterRoles
methods.description: Tests filtering of user roles based on inclusion and exclusion lists.

methods.name: testFilterRolesSupervisorForEmployee
methods.description: Verifies role filtering logic when acting as a supervisor for a subordinate employee.

methods.name: testGetHomePage
methods.description: Tests getting the homepage for a user based on roles and configuration.

methods.name: __convertRoleNamesToObjects
methods.description: Utility to convert array of role names into an array of UserRole objects for testing.

methods.name: compareUserRoles
methods.description: Helper to assert the expected vs actual list of roles by name.

methods.name: compareEmployees
methods.description: Helper to assert the expected vs actual list of Employee objects by employee number.

methods.name: compareArrays
methods.description: Utility to compare two arrays for equality in length and content.

methods.name: checkEmployees
methods.description: Checks that employee IDs are present in the actual output.

methods.name: getEmployeeIds
methods.description: Extracts list of employee numbers from Employee entity list.

methods.name: getEmployeePropertyList
methods.description: Returns a list of employee properties keyed by employee number.

methods.name: getObjectIds
methods.description: Extracts list of IDs from a list of objects.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForAdminUserRole
methods.description: Verifies that admin user can retrieve the expected allowed actions.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedForAdminAddEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission checking for admin when adding employee.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedForAdminAddActiveEmployee
methods.description: Checks if admin can perform actions in a specific workflow and state.

methods.name: testGetEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Fetches employees having a specific role, testing correct role assignment filtering.

methods.name: testGetActionableStatesValidActionsAndRole
methods.description: Checks that valid actions and roles produce correct actionable states.

methods.name: testGetActionableStatesInvalidAction
methods.description: Ensures invalid actions return empty states.

methods.name: testGetActionableStatesUserRoleWithNoWorkflowAccess
methods.description: Verifies that users without workflow access get empty actionable states.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEss
methods.description: Tests data group permissions for ESS users.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionForAdmin
methods.description: Checks data group permissions for admin users.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionSelf

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEssExcludeSupervisor
